title: After 3 boxes
text: It took me awhile to submit and order a box.  Yes, they're expensive.  But you should know that the second you load up the website.  They'll hook you with the initial "savings" and they send free boxes to YouTube influencers who won't say a bad thing.  You know all this.  Come on.  I've canceled and renewed a couple times - only when they send me one of their now weekly "We miss you, save $20" emails.  Most bad reviews I'm reading seem so upset they trash the actual product a bit much.  There's only been one thing I haven't liked, and they refunded me for it.  And if you could just get all they offer in a bulk store, people would be going to bulk stores and not even trying this.  As I said, I've bought 3 boxes and cancel each time, and I might just do it again.  I might even "splurge" and order their new a la carte jars to actually pick the things I liked the most.  But for all those who saw the prices, bought it, then complain about it - well I doubt it's JUST Candy Club you're doing that with.
label: neutral
